chapter.verse: Ka ta aw, kong hilhte thei in la, kong gente mangngilh ngei kei in.
Pilna thute limtakin ngai in la, na theihtel zawh nadingin hanciam in.
Hi hi, thu theih nading hanciam takpi in la, thumuh nading hahkat takpi in.
Ngun, ahih kei leh a kiseel sum manpha zon’ bangin, hahkatin pilna zong in.
Tua hi leh, Topa zahtakna thu na thei ding a, Pasian na theitel ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh pilna a piapa in Topa hi a, amah in pilna leh siamna a hilhpa ahi hi.
Pasian in thuman mite pilna guan a, midiktatte a hu hi.
Amah in thutang mite cing a, amah a itte kem hi.
Tua hi leh thuman leh thutang, ahoih leh a kilawm na thei ding hi.
Tua ciangin mipil na suak ding a, na pilna hangin nuam na sa ding hi.
Na thu ngaihsut theihna leh na thutelna in, nangmah hong hu-in,
a sia-in na gamtat khak ding hong kem ding a, kampauna tawh buaina a piangsak thei mi,
nuntakna manin a nungta lo, mawhna khuamial sungah a gamta,
a sia-in gamtat ding nuam a sa, asia-a gamtatna-ah a lungkim mahmah,
mi lungsim kawi, muan’ theih loh ding mite panin nang hong kem ding hi.
A pasal tungah citak loin a pasal a nusia, Pasian’ mai-ah a kiciamna a mangngilh, kamkhum mahmah tawh nang zol ding a hanciam, numei paktatte panin hong cing ding hi.
Tua nu’ inn-ah pai lecin sihna lampi zui na hi a, misite’ gam a zuan na hi hi.
Tua bang numei tawh mawhna a bawl mite, nuntakna nuam nei kik cih om ngei lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mihoihte’ gamtat bangin na gamta ding a, thuman mite’ gamtatna na zui ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi thuman, mi ginate, hih i leitungah teengin om ding uh a,
ahi zongin leitung panin migilote kilawn khia-in, singkung zung bawh bangin mawhneite kibotkhia ding hi.
